Usage: protonvpn config set kill-switch [OPTIONS] {off|standard}

  Configure Kill Switch to block internet if VPN connection drops.

Options:
  -h, --help  Show this message and exit.

  Values:
    off        Disable Kill Switch (internet always accessible)
    standard   Block internet only while VPN is active
  
  Examples:
    protonvpn config set kill-switch off
    protonvpn config set kill-switch standard
  
  Current Setting:
    Run 'protonvpn config list' to see current value.
  
  Behavior:
    - standard: Blocks internet if VPN drops during active connection
                Restores internet when you disconnect intentionally
